meta.name: The Jack Hanna Channel
meta.description:
TV-gids · geen videostreams.

Tijden hieronder: America/New_York.

21-11 01:41–02:05  Jack Hanna's Passport
  The Hannas explore primates, including baboons, orangutans, silver langurs, and lemurs.
21-11 02:05–02:29  Jack Hanna's Passport
  Hannas with blesbok, Tasmanian devils in Australia, jaguars in Ecuador, and guanacos in Patagonia.
21-11 02:29–02:53  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Join Jungle Jack as he counts down six species that turn heads!
21-11 02:53–03:17  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  From carnivores like lions to vegetarian friends,the elephants,Jungle Jack is gearing up for Feeding Frenzy!
21-11 03:17–03:42  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Join Jungle Jack for some super rare animal sightings!
21-11 03:42–04:06  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Join Jungle Jack for a weird and wonderful countdown celebrating some of the most unique animals on Earth!
21-11 04:06–04:30  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Come along with Jungle Jack as he uncovers some of nature’s most fearsome fangs!
21-11 04:30–04:54  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Join Jungle Jack as he counts down seven creatures so bizarre, you’ve gotta see them to believe them!
21-11 04:54–05:19  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Join Jungle Jack as he counts down the most extreme animal destinations on the planet!
21-11 05:19–05:43  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Jungle Jack takes off on a very special egg hunt, looking for creatures big and small that hatch from eggs!
21-11 05:43–06:07  Jack Hanna's Wild Countdown
  Discover how water impacts the lives of elephants, hippos, caiman, giraffes and more!
21-11 06:07–06:31  Jack Hanna's Into the Wild
  Join Jack and his daughter Kathaleen as they travel to Tanzania’s Tarangire National Park!
